purpose: Test whether the frozen V15.7 world model and the official full-budget Pi0.5 RL workers can coexist on one RTX 5090 by releasing only unused CUDA allocator cache at stage boundaries.
classification: resource-feasibility diagnostic; not a policy-quality result and not a Track2 success claim

semantics: observations remain numerically identical but cross the Ray channel as contiguous CPU tensors
the official 32-environment request is sharded into four ordered requests of at most eight samples
unused CUDA caching-allocator blocks are released after world-model prediction, after actor-to-rollout synchronization, and after each rollout result
no model parameter, observation value, action, reward, loss, optimizer, or policy budget is modified
